name: issue-factory
description: Autonomous Issue-to-Production Software Factory for SwipeNews. Triggered via webhook (POST /hooks/issue) or CLI, this workflow isolates a Git worktree, invokes the Builder Agent to implement code & tests, enforces deterministic Quality Gates (fmt, lint, typecheck, unit tests), runs a Bounded 4-Category Red-Team Adversary Agent, verifies CEL data assertions, pauses high-risk changes at a Human Approval Gate, and ships the verified commit to main.

issueId.description: Issue identifier from issues.json (ISSUE-101 bug, ISSUE-102 undo feature, ISSUE-103 high-risk filter feature)

mode.description: Builder execution mode ('fast' deterministic template or 'claude' live LLM)

risk.description: Optional risk level override ('low', 'normal', or 'high' to force manual approval gate)

jobs.name: factory
jobs.description: Sequential 8-stage autonomous software factory pipeline: Intake -> Build -> Quality Gate -> CEL Quality Assert -> Adversary Red-Team Audit -> CEL Adversary Assert -> Conditional Human Approval Gate -> Git Ship & Live App Reload.

steps.name: intake
steps.description: [Behavior: @coffeepy/factory-intake.prepare] Reads the issue specification (title, type, risk level, acceptance criteria) from issues.json, records the current HEAD commit SHA of swipenews/main, and provisions a clean, isolated Git worktree (.swamp/worktrees/<issueId>) so in-flight work never touches main until verified.

steps.name: build
steps.description: [Behavior: @coffeepy/factory-builder.implement] Runs the Builder Agent inside the isolated Git worktree to implement the bug fix or feature across src/engine.ts and src/server.ts, writes corresponding unit & regression tests in tests/engine_test.ts, formats the code, and snapshots the changed file list and git diff --stat into Swamp Data.

steps.name: quality-gate
steps.description: [Behavior: @coffeepy/factory-quality.check] Deterministic compiler & test gate (zero AI opinion). Executes 4 real tools against the worktree: (1) deno fmt --check, (2) deno lint, (3) deno check (strict TypeScript typechecking), and (4) deno test. Writes structured pass/fail booleans and total test count into Swamp Data.

steps.name: assert-quality
steps.description: [Task: CEL Assertion] Queries the versioned 'quality' snapshot produced by factory-quality and verifies via CEL that allPassed == true and at least 3 unit tests executed. Halts the pipeline immediately if any deterministic check failed.

task.message: All deterministic quality gates (fmt, lint, typecheck, and >=3 unit tests) must pass

steps.name: adversary-audit
steps.description: [Behavior: @coffeepy/factory-adversary.audit] Bounded Red-Team Adversary Agent. Audits the worktree against a fixed 4-category rubric so the review always converges: (1) spec_compliance, (2) state_invariants (savedCount/passedCount consistency), (3) boundary_safety (20x overflow swipes past empty deck & empty-history undo), and (4) xss_dom_safety (verifies zero innerHTML/document.write sinks).

steps.name: assert-adversary
steps.description: [Task: CEL Assertion] Evaluates the 'adversary' data snapshot to guarantee the Red-Team Adversary verdict is 'pass' with a perfect '4/4' rubric score before any code is allowed to reach sign-off or production merge.

task.message: Adversary red-team audit must pass all 4 rubric categories (4/4)

steps.name: human-signoff
steps.description: [Task: Manual Approval Gate] Human-in-the-loop governance gate. Guarded by CEL expression `risk != "high"`, so low/normal-risk issues (ISSUE-101, ISSUE-102) automatically skip this gate, while high-risk changes (ISSUE-103) suspend on swamp serve until approved in the Dashboard or CLI (then auto-resume via autoResume: true).

task.prompt: High-risk change detected for this issue (inspect with `swamp data query 'behavior("factory-intake") && name == "intake"' --select content`). Quality Gate and Adversary Red-Team Audit (4/4) have passed. Approve to merge and ship to main.

steps.name: ship
steps.description: [Behavior: @coffeepy/factory-ship.merge] Commits the verified worktree changes with a conventional commit message, fast-forwards swipenews/main, removes the temporary Git worktree, resets the live SwipeNews server (:8080), and records the shipped commit SHA for the @coffeepy/factory-report executive summary.
